title: Independent audit of Eliminating Whitney Umbrellas in Projective Group Realization

independent_controls.topology_review: Explicit CW presentation plus cellular homology control; not inferred from homology alone

corrections.summary: Explicitly restrict the Bierstone-Milman obstruction to proper birational modifications preserving the NC locus.
A covering need not preserve the group; do not assert that every covering changes its abstract isomorphism type.

verified_partial_results: All-degree invariant-ring derivation of the pinch-point quotient
Self-reproducing point-blowup chart and smooth double-line blowup equal to normalization
Conductor ideal and ramified conductor double cover
Reduced but nontransverse square-root base change
Irreducible NC projective surface with fundamental group Z
Projective normalization and smoothing controls changing the fundamental group
remaining_gap: No arbitrary-presentation NC self-gluing on one smooth connected projective normalization, with quotient existence, local NC verification, ample descent, and a complete pi_1 calculation, has been constructed.
literature_caveat: Official 2016 abstracts announce a stronger theorem, while the dated 2019 statement retains umbrellas. A full proof resolving that discrepancy was not verified.
estimate_interpretation: Uncalibrated inherited planning judgment, not a theorem, probability, or independently measurable completion fraction.
